ai.title: Enforce endturn in standard mode and refine agent instructions
ai.summary: The standard mode main prompt now explicitly requires the `end_turn` tool at the end of responses, mirroring the existing Lite mode behavior. Agent instructions were refined to remove redundant formatting and clarify package management, refactoring, and testing guidelines. These changes affect `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` and `backend/src/system-prompt/agent-instructions.md`.

eli5.text: In standard mode, the assistant is now required to end its response with a specific tool (end_turn) just like it already does in Lite mode, ensuring both modes behave consistently when wrapping up tasks. The behind-the-scenes instructions for the assistant were also lightly tidied up to remove extra formatting and clarify how to handle package updates, code cleanup, and testing. This is live today and affects internal behavior, so you wouldn't notice it directly, but the assistant's responses will end more uniformly across modes.
